whatThisIs: C17 (owner decision 2026-10-17): a product, tool or interview opens with its artisan's stated
address filled into the EMPTY boxes of its location card, marked on screen ("From <name>'s
record") and every box the researcher's to change. Both clients fill the same boxes and store
the same thing, so a sitting recorded on either client cannot be told apart by its data.
The web's components/forms/statedPrefill.ts is the other half of this contract.
provenanceRule: The mark is on screen only. Neither client writes a provenance key into location.extraMetadata.

vectors.name: a pincode is digits only, six at most
